bifrost: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (webcam viewfinder, V4L2), springboard/src/media/capture.rs, springboard/src/media/v4l2.rs, springboard/apps/photocraft-desktop
summary: ImageCaptureCore finds and controls PTP cameras and scanners over USB and imports their files. BifrOSt has no PTP, MTP, camera-device or scanner stack and no SDK API for these devices. Its only camera path is a V4L2 webcam viewfinder that saves JPEGs into the Photos folder.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/device_browser.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (check_devices, refresh_cameras, open_import); springboard/src/shell/camera/devices.rs; springboard/ui/src/device_browser.rs
features.note: The browser turns each device snapshot into added and removed events in id order, filters by camera or scanner, and keeps a preferred device; tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: nothing enumerates real cameras or scanners and no hotplug source feeds the snapshots, which needs hardware and a Midget check.

features.feature: Camera device control (PTP tethering, capture, clock, battery)
features.apple: ICCameraDevice, ICCameraDeviceDelegate, requestTakePicture, requestEnableTethering, requestSendPTPCommand, requestSyncClock
features.note: Tethering is gated on the take-picture capability, a capture needs tethering first, clock sync reports the offset before it and battery levels are clamped; all tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: there is no PTP or USB camera transport, so tethered capture, the remote shutter and raw PTP commands need hardware.

features.feature: Camera file browsing and download (contents, files, folders)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/camera_device.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/camera/import.rs; springboard/src/shell/camera/devices.rs (contents_of, import_files); springboard/ui/src/camera_device.rs
features.note: The contents tree lists folders and files, builds paths, and filters files by media kind; tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: no transport lists or copies files from a live camera's storage, and photos import from a device is not implemented; both need hardware.

features.feature: File metadata and thumbnails (EXIF, GPS, burst, video)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (writes EXIF orientation and date into saved JPEGs), springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/imageio/exif.rs (parse_block reads EXIF, GPS and orientation tags)
features.note: Our own captures get EXIF orientation and date on write, and the TIFF block reader in exif.rs parses EXIF, GPS and orientation tags from files on disk. Gap: no device metadata, burst grouping or device thumbnail reader is wired to the camera model, which needs hardware.

A delete request returns one result per index, refuses every index while the camera is locked, and removes a deleted file from the listing without reusing its index; tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: no delete command reaches a real camera, which needs hardware.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 16 tests. Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No SANE or scanner transport and no scanner SDK API. springboard/ui/src/print.rs covers printing only.

features.feature: Scanning (overview, scan, transfer mode, document type)
features.apple: requestOverviewScan, requestScan, cancelScan, transferMode, documentUTI, downloadsDirectory
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No scan job API. The closest pieces are springboard/sdk/src/share.rs and springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs, which handle outputs but not scan jobs.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-33, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No credential flow for scanners.

features.apple: com.apple.security.device.usb entitlement (Important note in the framework overview)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (bubblewrap sandbox, binds /sys and /run/udev read-only), springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (file grants)
features.note: The sandbox binds udev read-only but has no per-app USB device grant, so an app cannot be given a device node the way the entitlement allows.

features.feature: Camera permission prompt (NSCameraUsageDescription, Photos library entitlement)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/camera/mod.rs (camera opens only when the app starts; shows Camera not available on failure)
features.note: The camera starts and stops with the app, but there is no usage-description string or permission prompt to match Apple's model.

features.apple: ICReturn, ICLegacyReturn, ICReturnConnectionError, ICReturnDownloadError, ICReturnPTPDeviceError and the other ICReturn* error structs
features.note: These describe the PTP and scanner transports, which BifrOSt does not have. The error model is tied to those transports.
Deprecated Apple symbol. BifrOSt uses no run-loop modes.

features.apple: ImageCaptureCore Constants, Data Types, Enumerations, Macros
features.note: The device kind, device mask, capability bits and media kinds are typed and tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: the transfer modes and scanner functional-unit types still need hardware to verify their values. Refreshed 2026-10-17: sdk scan_session::ScanSession wraps one SANE device (scanimage) and scans pages to files (tests scan_session::tests), so a scanner transport exists.

gaps: No PTP or USB camera enumeration reaches the device browser (ui device_browser). sdk device_registry::DeviceWatch polls sysfs devices by class and could feed it.
No PTP or MTP transport, so no camera file listing, download, delete or tethered capture (ICCameraDevice, ICCameraFile).
No per-app USB device grant to match com.apple.security.device.usb in springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs.
Camera permission model: no usage-description string or prompt for camera access, unlike NSCameraUsageDescription.
Photos import from a device is absent; springboard/apps/photocraft-desktop has no import code in this checkout.
